t: A federation created in 1887 joining Cochinchina, Annam, Tonkin and Cambodia, with Laos added after 1893.
Rice, rubber and state monopolies on opium, salt and alcohol made it France’s most valuable Asian possession.
Japanese occupation and the First Indochina War ended French rule at Dien Bien Phu and Geneva in 1954.
dyk: Paul Doumer, who built Indochina’s federal government and the Hanoi bridge first named after him, later became President of France and was assassinated in 1932.
ev: France creates the Indochinese Union on 17 October
The Franco-Siamese crisis adds the Lao lands east of the Mekong
The seat of government moves from Saigon to Hanoi
The Indochinese Communist Party is founded and the Yen Bai mutiny is crushed
Japanese troops enter northern Indochina after France’s defeat
Japan overthrows French rule; Ho Chi Minh proclaims the Democratic Republic of Vietnam
The First Indochina War begins after fighting in Haiphong and Hanoi
Defeat at Dien Bien Phu and the Geneva Accords end French Indochina

f.predecessor: French Cochinchina; Nguyen dynasty; French protectorate of Cambodia
f.successor: Democratic Republic of Vietnam; State of Vietnam; Kingdom of Laos; Kingdom of Cambodia
